subject: Geopolitics
title: Climate Change and Border Stress
description: A quick, practical guide to Climate Change and Border Stress.

hook.text: Bangladesh will lose 17% of its land to rising seas. Where will 20 million climate refugees go? India already fences.

buildup.text: Climate change will redraw maps. Coastal nations shrink. Fertile land shifts. Water sources cross new borders.

discovery.text: Climate migration will pressure borders that were never designed for mass movement. Walls can't stop the sea.

twist.text: No legal framework protects climate refugees. The 1951 Refugee Convention covers war, not rising oceans.

climax.text: Pacific island nations may disappear entirely. Tuvalu already digitized its territory in case it goes underwater.

punchline.text: Nature doesn't respect the lines we drew.

quiz.question: Why are climate refugees not protected by the 1951 Refugee Convention?
options: The convention covers war, not environmental displacement
Climate change was not acknowledged when it was written
